guideline_description: Patients presenting with chest pain should receive rapid assessment including symptom evaluation, vital signs monitoring, ECG when appropriate, and risk stratification.
Patients with sudden neurological symptoms require immediate evaluation, neurological assessment, imaging consideration, and urgent specialist involvement.
keywords: stroke, weakness, speech difficulty, neurological emergency

guideline_description: Patients with suspected respiratory infection should undergo clinical assessment, oxygen monitoring when required, and appropriate medical management.
Diabetic patients require monitoring of glucose levels, medication review, lifestyle assessment, and prevention of complications.
Patients with elevated blood pressure require assessment of severity, risk factors, medication review, and cardiovascular risk evaluation.
Patients with suspected fractures require injury assessment, imaging when indicated, pain management, and orthopedic evaluation.
Patients with abdominal pain require assessment of location, severity, associated symptoms, examination findings, and appropriate investigations.
Patients with severe allergic reactions require immediate emergency assessment and stabilization according to emergency protocols.
Patients with kidney-related conditions require evaluation of renal function, medication safety, and appropriate specialist management.
Radiology requests should be clinically justified, matched to appropriate imaging modality, and performed using radiation safety principles.
Cancer patients require coordinated multidisciplinary care, treatment planning, monitoring, and follow-up according to oncology protocols.
Patients presenting with mental health concerns require confidential assessment, risk evaluation, and appropriate psychological or psychiatric support.
